invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Drawable unless an exception is thrown; an exception is thrown (not a return) when all lookups fail.
By construction, the method returns an object of type Drawable, and assigns to 'drawable' only compatible objects.
The parameter 'name' is used as a key for lookups and is always required to be non-null; otherwise, exception would be thrown at lookups.
Both 'name' and the returned 'Drawable' are expected to be non-null for correct behavior of the method.
At successful exit, the returned result must always be a non-null Drawable instance.
